relations.rationale: Being treasurer has no bearing on relative height compared to Hugo.
Kai arriving first is consistent with and supports Noor arriving a few minutes after Kai.
If Kai arrived first, this supports the claim that Ana arrived later than Kai.
Kai arriving first has no logical connection to the cast gathering their things later.

Kai's stretching activity has no bearing on class assignment with Noor.

Noor's arrival time relative to Kai does not determine Ana's arrival time relative to Hugo.
Noor arriving after Kai does not establish anything about Ana's arrival relative to Kai.
Noor's arrival timing is unrelated to Rosa's reminder about theater closing hours.
Noor humming a song is unrelated to Hugo apologizing for traffic.
Noor humming has no bearing on height comparison between Rosa and Hugo.
Noor humming under her breath does not relate to her class assignment with Hugo.
Noor humming while waiting is unrelated to Hugo practicing his lines elsewhere.

Kai and Noor sharing a class is unrelated to Ana's arrival time relative to Kai.
